chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Abu Al-Hasan Al-Rida (peace be upon him), said:
I asked him about a man who marries a woman and also marries the mother of her children (from another husband). He said: There is no problem with that.

So I said to him: It has reached us from your father that Ali ibn Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) married the daughter of Al-Hasan ibn Ali (peace be upon him) and the mother of the children of Al-Hasan. And that is, a man from our companions asked me to ask you about it.
So he said: It is not like this. Rather, Ali ibn Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) married the daughter of Al-Hasan and the mother of a child for Ali ibn Al-Husayn, the one who was martyred among you.
So he wrote about that to Abd Al-Malik ibn Marwan, so he criticized Ali ibn Al-Husayn (peace be upon him). So he wrote to him regarding that, and he wrote to him the answer.
So when he read the letter, he said: Surely, Ali ibn Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) humbles himself, and surely Allah raises him.

key_terms.أُمَّ وَلَدٍ: Mother of a child (from the master)
key_terms.عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ مَرْوَانَ: Abd Al-Malik ibn Marwan, Umayyad Caliph
key_terms.عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ: Ali ibn Al-Husayn, the fourth Imam

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on marrying a woman and her mother from another husband, and what is the corrected historical account of Imam Zayn al-Abidin's marriage?
ai.summary: Imam Al-Rida (peace be upon him) clarifies the permissibility of a man marrying a woman and her 'Umm al-Walad' from her previous marriage to her father, correcting a historical misconception regarding the lineage of the mother of the child in Imam Zayn al-Abidin’s marriage. He elucidates that the 'mother of the child' was actually the mother of a child born to Imam Zayn al-Abidin himself, not to Imam Hasan, thereby resolving the apparent contradiction in the narrations. This incident highlights the scholarly rigor in verifying historical reports and their jurisprudential implications, as evidenced by the correspondence with Abd Al-Malik ibn Marwan, who praised the Imam’s humility and status.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the man who married the woman and he married a mother of the children of her father.
So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem with that’.

So I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘It has reached me from your<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> that Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> married the daughter of Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup> and a mother of the children of Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, and that is that a man from our companions asked me that I should asked you<sup>asws</sup> about it’.

So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is not like this. But rather, Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> married a daughter of Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> and a mother of the children of Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>, the one who was murdered with you.
So that was written about to Abdul Malik Bin Marwan, so he criticized upon Ali Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>. So he<sup>asws</sup> wrote to him the answer regarding that.
So when he read the letter, he said, ‘Surely, Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> humbles himself<sup>asws</sup> but Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Raises him<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr who has said the following:
“I once asked al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man who marries a woman then marries the mother of the child of her father. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not unlawful.’

I then asked, ‘It is narrated to us from your father, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, that Ali ibn al-Husayn, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, married, daughter of al-Hassan ibn Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and mother of the child of al-Hassan because a certain person of our people asked me to ask you about it.

He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not that way. Ali ibn al-Husayn, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, had married daughter of al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and mother of the child of Ali ibn al-Husayn who was murdered with you.
It was reported to ‘Abd al-Malik ibn Marwan who blamed Ali ibn al-Husayn, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about it and Ali ibn al-Husayn, ‘Alayhi al- Salam, wrote to him the answer.
After reading the letter he said, ‘Ali ibn al-Husayn lowers himself but Allah raises him up.’”
